column3: Complete type — overrides ALL other rules
Lock job — auto-pilot route around, no movement
Force tech — override Preferred Tech (RE), Workload Fairness (WB)
Hard time constraint — narrower than Service Hours (WB), Max Shift End (WB), Max Last Appt (SC)
Strict cutoff — wins Max Shift End (WB) if earlier
Block tech outside region — wins Preferred Tech (RE)
Filter tech by skill — win Preferred Tech (RE)
Hold week/month — win movement_limit (CR) if movement exceeds period
Even balance — soft, overridden by force_tech
Display only — does not affect routing
Strict — no fallback, but under force_tech
